reference.pathophysiology: Arrhythmias arise from enhanced automaticity, triggered activity and re entry circuits around scar or accessory pathways, each answering to channel specific blockade that also reshapes normal conduction and repolarisation dangerously. QT prolonging potassium blockade enables early afterdepolarisations and torsades, while sodium blockade in scarred ventricles slows conduction into lethal re entry, explaining trial proven proarrhythmic harm.
